attributes.residual: PREMISE CORRECTION for the taxonomy's 'Item 37 past-end sites': the Item record does not need extending either. include/game/item.h maps Item contiguously 0x00 -> 0xF0 (info, OBJGRP objgrp, atree[0x48], coll_offset, ctriidx..fxhittime, data[0x14]) with the 0xF0 stride confirmed in the header from the DOL's own `mulli rX,idx,240`. The sites that look 'past end' are reads INTO the declared `u8 data[0x14]` union blob at 0xDC -- e.g. generate_now's `u8* p = it->data; *(s16*)(p + 8)`, a per-item-subtype timer at 0xE4. That is a UNION-INTERIOR naming problem, not a missing tail: the same 20 bytes are reinterpreted per subtype (anim/oanim/texmod/psys), so a single flat field name would be wrong, and a union member is forbidden in this shared header by the cascade law. Correct future move is a file-LOCAL per-subtype view in each consuming TU, matching the project's existing DSItem/CritterItemView convention. 50 sites remain: the union-interior set, the Player-base and large `player_runtime`/`overlay_runtime` blob reads (`runtime + idx*0x68 + 0x3E74`, a level-runtime record with no established struct), and the excluded parked/capped function bodies.
